entities.summary: The Soju Ga clan is one of the Korean clans. Their Bon-gwan is in Suzhou, Jiangsu, China, known as Soju (Korean: 소주) in Korean. According to the research conducted by the Korean government in 1985, there were 7894 members of the Soju Ga clan. Their founder was Ga Yu-yak who was a soldier dispatched by Ming dynasty’s Wanli Emperor to combat opponents in Japanese invasions of Korea (1592–98).
